description: This file defines booking-related actions and UI logic for a booking management system, including functions for generating action buttons, handling booking state, and determining UI element visibility.

methods.name: getPendingActions
methods.description: Generates a list of pending booking actions such as confirm and reject based on context.

methods.name: getCancelEventAction
methods.description: Returns the cancel action with label and disabled state based on context.

methods.name: getVideoOptionsActions
methods.description: Provides actions related to viewing recordings and session details for a booking.

methods.name: getEditEventActions
methods.description: Returns a list of editing actions for a booking, including reschedule, reroute, change location, add members, and reassign.

methods.name: getReportAction
methods.description: Provides a report booking action if not already reported.

methods.name: getAfterEventActions
methods.description: Returns actions after an event, such as charging a card or marking no-show.

methods.name: shouldShowPendingActions
methods.description: Determines if pending actions should be shown based on booking status.

methods.name: shouldShowEditActions
methods.description: Determines if edit actions should be shown based on booking status.

methods.name: shouldShowRecurringCancelAction
methods.description: Checks if recurring cancel action should be visible.

methods.name: shouldShowIndividualReportButton
methods.description: Checks if individual report button should be visible.

methods.name: isActionDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a specific action should be disabled based on booking state and action type.

methods.name: getActionLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a given action based on context.
